label: GAMEBOARD
comment: World (i) of the families round, matter alone (HIGHLIGHTS.md, Every family run on the engine and seen to work; the advisor's blinds, #1563 comment 5928483084; ALGEBRA.md, The bound body is one Node, The two branches, row (s), row (u), row (w)): one body of the matter family at rest on the rule's own universe (examples/events/rule.json: gravity at the level weight 1,000, the charge at 1, the binding holder [2400, 2401] at 1, matter [4000, 6000]), on an open box (every axis open with the faces' layer one Node deep: a board periodic on every axis has no rest), laid by the generator (tools/pixel_mode.py) as its standing record in the wells its own form lays, declared with one Node carrying its quanta in the engine's count (ALGEBRA.md, The count's unit: the engine's count is about three times the advisor's vacuum share along the compact branch, 3.7 at the Node and 3.1 in all at 2,000). Two worlds: `pixel`, the compact branch, `quanta` quanta on the box of `shape` (the generator reaches the compact pixel at this count, 9,451 quanta at the centre Node with a tail of a few Links; at 8,000 and at 7,000 on the same box it reaches the wide branch, a body of rms radius 3.9 Links with about 50 quanta at the centre, and at 4,500 it refuses the body by name as a cloud, its standing rotation under the band's top (every lay named here is the generator's on main 3fe40aeb's engine, before the self-read round, whose rest differs: every held row reads the content at the Node's pace, and bodies above 2 / 27 of content have no rest; the worlds are laid anew by the builder, with --modes, on the finished engine, and no world laid on the old engine is committed)), and `cloud`, the wide branch, the advisor's cloud of 4,000 quanta on the 41-cube (row (w): the generator's own start is the shape of the body's well; the wide start b_i = exp(-r_i / R_0) with R_0 = 2 Gamma / C is not the generator's, so the generator refuses this body by name as a cloud, which the build prints: the lay of this folder read 'the body of 4000 quanta about the Node [20, 20, 20] is a cloud: its standing reading rotates at [932, 701], not above the band's top 2 x 4000 / 6000 and below 2', 1.3295 against the top 1.3333 and the advisor's 1.351; the world file stands declared without a mode file, the loader refusing it at load until the generator lays the wide branch from the wide start, R_0 = 2 Gamma / C Links, the line row (w) names). Headless, `ticks` intervals, the reading at the window's ends by tools/body_rest.py, a GameBoard reading and no click. The run is not performed in the round that prepares it: the families round runs once on the finished engine (the owner, 2026-10-01, 13:00 and 17:10).
reading: per world (tools/body_rest.py, GameBoard): at the window's ends the body's three levels about one interval at its centre and their ratio (next + before) / now = 2 cos omega_b, its quanta at the centre Node and over the board, the centroid of its share and the second moment about it (the rms radius squared), its well over the board (D summed over T), its record's levels along each axis from the centre with the ratios of successive levels (e^(-kappa) per Link on the tail), every held row's level along the same axes, and the books (the share's drift from the lay).

pixel.window_of_mass: the compact pixel's count c in [0.2255 Gamma, Gamma div 2) = [1,353, 3,000) in the advisor's unit under the Node pace, the edge at 0.345 Gamma = 2,070 under the two-end pace (a one-Node body's Links read the level at one end only), in the engine's count about three times these (The count's unit); below the edge no compact pixel stands and the body is the cloud, at the horizon the pace 0 and the guard ends the run by name
pixel.rest_rotation: 2 cos omega_b from the three levels at the centre: the one-Node line 2 cos omega_b = 2 - 2 (den - num) (p_0 / Gamma)^2 at its own well, omega_b 0.841 at the edge (2 cos omega_b at the band's top 1.3333) and 0.464 at c = 0.451 Gamma = 2,706 (1.789); the first look's line with the tail (row (s)) 1.4317 at 2,000 at the Node, the period 8.13 intervals, and 1.5199 at 3,000, the period 8.88, in the advisor's unit; the generator's lay of this world reads 12789 / 8310 = 1.539 with the period 9.0 (the mode file, before any run); the run holds it: over at least three periods the form returns within the mode's level at the Node b_0
pixel.tail: kappa = acosh((9 / 2) cos omega_b - 2) per Link, the ratio of successive levels along an axis e^(-kappa): 0.45 at 0.25 Gamma (e^(-kappa) 0.640), 1.27 at 0.417 Gamma (0.281) under the Node pace; 0.63 at 0.417 Gamma and 0.98 at 0.5 Gamma under the two-end pace; the tail ends within three Links
pixel.drift: the count's drift at rest 0 to the rounding: the books' drift within the rounding walk of 0.058 quanta per unit over the run, the centroid where it was laid
pixel.form: D = b^2 (2 - 2 cos omega_b) at rest at the Node, b the largest whose square is at most c T den div (2 den - a) for the clock pair [a, den] of 2 cos omega_b; the well over the count 0.712 at 2,000 in the advisor's unit, 0.70 at the edge to 0.39 at the horizon (row (u)); the inertia 1.154 of the count at 2,000 is not read in this world
pixel.screening: the binding holder's screening at R = 20 changes the one-Node Green's function by under one percent (kappa_b = 0.05 per Link); gravity at the level weight 1,000 writes under two levels at the Node and nothing beyond one Link

cloud.rest_rotation: 2 cos omega_b = 1.351 above the band's top 1.3333, 4,000 quanta on the open 41-cube at Gamma = 6,000 (The two branches; row (w))
cloud.radius: the rms radius 8.7 Links, 2.6 quanta at the centre Node, a quantum at about 500 Nodes and none moving in the mean, the record shared by ten thousand Nodes
cloud.well: the well 0.985 of its count; the inertia 1.06 of its count and the fall 0.92 of a free packet's are not read in this world (the generator's computed numbers, 5904437672, now the run's blind)
cloud.drift: the count kept, the centroid where it was laid
cloud.lay: not laid: the generator's iteration from its own start (the shape of the body's well) reaches a reading of 2 cos omega_b = 932 / 701 = 1.3295 at 4,000 on the 41-cube, under the band's top, and refuses the body by name as a cloud; the wide start of row (w), b_i = exp(-r_i / R_0) with R_0 = 2 Gamma / C, is the lay this world needs and the generator does not make yet

blind.status: computed from the law's lines (the one-Node line, the first look's row (s), the cloud's fixed point, row (w)) at Gamma = 6,000, nothing read back from a run; the second number where two are given is the two-end pace's; the lay's own reading of the rotation (the mode file's clock pair) is the generator's and stands beside the blind
blind.fence: GameBoard: a rotation at a Node, a tail, a centroid and a well are readings of the record and no click; what a body does in the words of the clicks is the compact pixel's words (ALGEBRA.md, What a body does, in the words of the clicks)
